The 20th anniversary revival of Suzan-Lori Parks’ Pulitzer Prize-winning play, "Topdog/Underdog," is just as powerful and absorbing as before with its story of two African American brothers Booth and Lincoln who are searching for the American Dream in opposite ways.
Whatever echoes of other dramatists that might be heard at the Golden these nights, Parks is a singular talent with an important voice of her own and this may be her finest work.
